title: Answer: life, selves, worlds and conscious acts are emergent processes

statements.text: Emergent processes, with global-to-local influence on their components, include the autopoiesis that constitutes a living cell, the self and world it brings forth, neural assemblies, and conscious cognitive acts. Being alive is instantiated in the emergent process of autopoiesis.

sources.quote: the property of being alive as such does not emerge, but is instantiated in the emergent process of autopoiesis that constitutes living cells
